beats.name: open
beats.why: cold open — photo dragged onto the canvas, the task starting; short and punchy to match the fast/energetic brief tone

beats.name: panel-reveal
beats.why: push-in reveal of the Photo inspector — Remove Background button + full adjustment-slider stack; strongest UI-establishing shot, title card lands here

beats.name: kickoff
beats.why: the one real click in this segment — user hits send and the assistant flips to Working…; reads clearly as 'go' and bridges into the AI doing the work

beats.name: before-after
beats.why: the money shot — template flips from flat/text-only to a fully composited hero card as the AI-cut photo lands; strongest proof of automatic bg removal + template compositing

beats.name: badge-proof
beats.why: Inspector Photo tab's 'BACKGROUND: applied / redo' badge and slider stack — a crisp concrete confirmation beat right after the reveal, without needing narration

beats.name: recrop-payoff
beats.why: second wow moment — an AI-applied oversize recrop snaps in under 3s, flat cutout to full hero crop with environment revealed; push-in motion breaks up the run of static UI shots

beats.name: ready-handoff
beats.why: assistant flips Working… to Ready with an empty chat input — a clean beat cueing the handoff from AI back to the human before the manual-edit close

beats.name: manual-edit
beats.why: user clicks into the stat label and starts a manual correction with the color-swatch toolbar popping up — the brief's closing point that the person stays in control after the AI does the heavy lifting

beats.name: close-logo
beats.why: wide pull-out pairing the finished poster with its isolated cutout as the assistant confirms 'Resolved' — a calm, breathing close for the logo
